html:
CRYPTO NEWS — August 5, 2026

Bitcoin consolidated into a tight range overnight as U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a net inflow of $170.1 million on August 4, with institutional buyers using the early morning price dip to add to their holdings. The bounce held, but don't mistake calm for conviction. Fear & Greed inched up from extreme fear to just plain fear—a sign the panic is settling, not reversing. ETH remains underwater on the week despite minor daily gains, while Polkadot and the XRP Ledger Ecosystem were the largest gainers over the past day. Funding rates across all three majors sit benign and below 0.50%, confirming no overleveraged bull trap is building. Stablecoins remain abundant at $255B+ in circulation. The macro backdrop is still a headwind, but spot accumulation keeps nibbling at the lows.

TODAY'S HIGHLIGHTS

Bitcoin ETFs Snap the Bleed—$170M Inflow Signals Institutional Resurfacing
BlackRock's IBIT led with $111.4 million in net inflows, while Fidelity's FBTC recorded $33.4 million. This reversal came as equities tanked, a classic pattern: institutions rotate to crypto when traditional markets stumble. One good day doesn't restart the bull, but it stops the narrative from being "everything's redeeming." Traders: watch for follow-through inflows tomorrow and this week. If they dry up again, we're just seeing tactical dip-buys, not a structural shift. The real tell is whether this becomes a multi-week streak—historically that's when Bitcoin finds legs.

Nasdaq Bitcoin Index Options—Delayed, Not Dead
The SEC granted a petition by CME Group to review the approval of Nasdaq Bitcoin Index Options, automatically staying the product launch pending a full commission review with statements due by August 24. Regulatory setbacks look negative on the surface, but often they're just process friction. The fact the SEC didn't kill it outright suggests the product has institutional backing. Traders should view this as a near-term headwind resolved by month-end. Mark August 24 on your calendar.

Altcoins Rotate—Polkadot and XRP Take the Lead
Polkadot and the XRP Ledger Ecosystem were the largest gainers over the past day, signaling selective demand outside of BTC and ETH. This breadth divergence is typical in fear regimes: capital hunts yield and narrative. Both tokens have regulatory tailwinds and institutional interest driving them higher while larger caps consolidate. Traders: use this as a range-burn play. If you're stuck between BTC support and resistance, alt pairs often break out first and telegraph the next macro move.

WATCH LIST

Next 24-48h: Bitcoin needs to hold $63,405 support and test $64,450 (today's 24h high) with volume to signal conviction. A break above $64,450 opens $65,000+ resistance; fail below the 24h low and we're headed for $62,000–$62,500, where weak technicals could cascade into a liquidation flush. ETH remains the fragile link—still down 2.60% weekly while SOL is flat. Watch for either relief or reversal in that divergence. Fear & Greed at 27 and e-trade.ai thermometer at 37/100 leave room for both capitulation and a slow grind higher; stablecoin reserves ($255B) are dry powder waiting for the next dip. ETF flows are the short-term barometer—sustained inflows could flip sentiment, sustained outflows confirm the fear regime is far from done.

See you tomorrow—stay sharp, keep your stops tight, and don't chase the bounce on one day of inflows. Structure first, greed later.
